features: logged-in homepage users receive a polished 1-5 star feedback experience with optional topic and written feedback
feedback is now submitted to a server-side Supabase endpoint instead of relying on browser-local storage as the data source
server validates ratings, topics and message length and rate-limits repeated submissions from the same DLavie user ID
feedback database is RLS-enabled and browser database roles have no direct table access
feedback storage excludes email, password, OTP, IP address and payment information
support-admin mode now includes Feedback Insights with average rating, rating distribution, topic breakdown, low-rating count and recent comments
existing public ecosystem credits, Utility Orb, receipt, transaction and catalog improvements remain active
note: v31 turns the feedback popup into an actionable server-backed product feedback loop with admin analytics.
